name: M-VAVE FM-1 hub
what: one page listing a dozen open-source FM-1 firmwares (Felucca, SLOOP groovebox, zp12 sampler, X0X drums, Jangada drones...) with in-browser Web MIDI install. the page this one is modeled on.

name: Bruce
device: M5Stack Cardputer, StickC, CYD and other ESP32 gadgets
what: offensive-security toolbox firmware for pocket ESP32 boards: wifi, BLE, IR, sub-GHz modules. web installer on the project page.

name: ESP32 Marauder
device: ESP32 dev boards, Flipper wifi dev board
what: wifi and bluetooth analysis suite for cheap ESP32 boards.

name: Tasmota
device: Sonoff and thousands of other ESP8266/ESP32 smart plugs and bulbs
what: local-control firmware for cheap wifi smart-home gear, with a browser installer.

name: ESPHome
what: describe a device in YAML, get firmware that talks to Home Assistant.

name: Meshtastic
device: LoRa boards: Heltec, LilyGO T-Beam, RAK, T-Echo
what: off-grid mesh text messaging over LoRa on $20-ish boards. browser flasher.

name: UV-K5 custom (egzumer)
what: one of the best-known community firmwares for the cheap UV-K5: extra features, wider band coverage, spectrum view.

name: UV-K5 custom (armel)
what: another fork in the UV-K5 family tree, with its own UI and feature set.

name: IronOS
device: Pinecil, Miniware TS100 / TS80 soldering irons
what: open firmware that turns a pocket soldering iron into a properly tunable one. flash by dragging a file onto its USB drive.

name: Thingino
device: cheap Ingenic-based IP cameras (Wyze, Cinnamon and more)
what: open firmware for cheap cameras, local-only, no cloud account.

name: OpenIPC
device: IP cameras on Goke, HiSilicon, SigmaStar, Ingenic chips
what: a linux firmware project for the long tail of whitelabel IP cameras.

name: OpenWrt
device: hundreds of consumer routers and access points
what: the original: linux for routers. the firmware selector builds an image for your exact model.

name: Klipper
what: offloads motion planning to a Pi so a cheap printer board prints faster and tunes better.

name: Marlin
what: the default firmware under a huge share of hobby 3D printers.

name: Betaflight
what: racing-quad flight control firmware, flashed from the browser configurator.

name: INAV
device: FPV drone and fixed-wing flight controllers
what: adds GPS navigation and return-to-home to hobby flight controllers.

name: ArduPilot
what: autopilot firmware for nearly anything that moves.

name: Momentum
what: popular custom firmware for the Flipper Zero with a web updater.

name: Unleashed
what: long-running Flipper Zero custom firmware with extended sub-GHz support.

name: Knulli
device: Anbernic and other budget retro handhelds
what: retro-gaming OS for cheap handhelds, runs from an SD card.

name: ROCKNIX
device: Anbernic, Powkiddy, AYN and other ARM handhelds
what: community linux distribution for a wide range of ARM retro handhelds.

name: ArkOS
device: Odroid Go Super and RK3326 handhelds
what: one of the older custom OS images for cheap Rockchip handhelds.

name: Rockbox
device: old iPods, Sansa, iriver and other DAPs
what: the elder statesman of custom firmware: open-source player firmware since 2001.

name: Modwerk (Octamod)
what: hub for browsing mods; includes octabam DSP effects. processes your official OS file locally in the browser.

name: octabam
what: reverb and delay with a shared send bus across eight tracks. patches your own copy of the official OS; no manufacturer files are hosted.

name: Digisophie
what: metallic percussion synth with four models (Fuse, Boom, Pipe, Shard). needs the elekloader tool and your own OS 1.53.

name: Modded Cycles
what: loads Model:Samples OS, adds USB multitrack audio and latching mute. patches your own copy of the official OS; no manufacturer files are hosted.

name: Model-TG
what: seventh sampler machine with granular, stretch and Karplus-Strong modes, plus a slice editor. patches your own copy of the official OS; no manufacturer files are hosted.

name: DOOM OS
what: alpha shadow OS with grid sequencer, piano roll and mixer; the original firmware stays put.

name: Blackbox Mod
what: SP-12/S950/MPC60 fidelity modes, 24dB filter, granular delay, chord shapes. built on firmware 3.1.9.

name: Open500
what: tiny loader inside the official OS that loads features as WAV add-ons: auto chop, sample FX, 16-step grid sequencer.

name: op1repacker
what: unpack, modify and repack OP-1 firmware into a valid installable file, from the op-forums research.

name: X0X
what: 909/808 drums and two 303 acid generators, a Felucca fork (beta).
